sync.edit_note: Room-level index for the per-wall sync files. Edit this file when a wall is added, renamed, or reordered. Wall dimensions themselves live only in the wall files.

structural_id_policy.description: Like structural elements share one continuous numbering sequence across the whole room. Columns run C1, C2, C3... and zones run Z1, Z2, Z3... regardless of which wall they sit on.
structural_id_policy.note: Wall 1 consumes C1-C4 and Z1-Z5, so the next new column is C5 and the next new zone is Z6 unless the user specifies otherwise.
structural_id_policy.opening_suffixes: An opening with casings expands into <id>A left casing, <id>B unit, <id>C right casing. It consumes a single zone number.

rules: Global structural IDs are continuous across the room and do not restart wall by wall.
Clear wall returns beside an opening remain separate locked zones and are not absorbed into the opening unit.
Each wall's expected_total_width must equal the sum of that wall's segment widths within 0.001.
Photoreal rendering uses a persistent structural lock rule.
Renderer may color, texture, shadow, and enhance lines only inside the measured framework.
The registry is the measurement authority. Renders are presentation output only.
